queries_run: Arrow Electronics distribution channel disruption OR shift 2026
Arrow Electronics business model transition platform 2026 ArrowSphere

findings.claim: 10-K 說明 ECS 部門透過 ArrowSphere 雲端市集與管理平台（含 AI 數位 go-to-market）協助 VAR/MSP 銷售雲端產品，屬平台化方向
findings.excerpt: Enabling customer cloud-based solutions through ArrowSphere, the company’s cloud marketplace and management platform, which helps VARs and MSPs to manage, differentiate, and scale their cloud businesses while providing the business intelligence and tools that IT solution providers need to drive growth.

findings.claim: 10-K 競爭段落指出公司亦與供應商爭奪客戶，並面對進入物流、電子目錄經銷與電商供應鏈服務市場的競爭者
findings.excerpt: The company also competes for customers with its suppliers.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋摘要另有 Dell 終止與 ECS 北美經銷關係、TI 直銷增加等說法，但未讀到可逐字複製的原文，未列為 finding；Arrow 未揭露 ArrowSphere 營收。

clues.claim: Edgewater 2026 年 1 月報告：TI 增加直接銷售、TE 將部分車用銷售轉入經銷，ADI 亞太整合有利 Arrow
clues.source: passive-components.eu component distribution supply chain January 2026
